vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1644: Hook-driven progressive conversation titling

narratives.Problem: Conversation titles stick on 'New conversation' because titling is coupled to HTTP message-delivery handlers: blank-start rows get title_source='default', the first-message path is AI-only, backgroundAi.cheapMode disables that AI path entirely, the UserPromptSubmit hook drops the prompt text it already receives, no title-changed event exists (UI relies on React Query polling), first-answer refinement polls the JSONL transcript every 1.5s for up to 10 minutes, and explicit user retitles are stored as title_source='ai' so automatic refinement can overwrite them. Live DB 2026-07-07: 30 non-archived stuck rows, all ended, none with a resolvable transcript.
narratives.Proposal: Make hooks the canonical title trigger. New internal-token-authenticated endpoints POST /api/hooks/user-prompt-submit and POST /api/hooks/turn-complete resolve the conversation via getConversationByClaudeSessionId(session_id) (mirroring the existing /api/hooks/permission-event pattern). On first prompt for a titleSource='default' row, set a deterministic prompt-derived title (source 'auto') with zero model calls, working under cheapMode. AI improvement stays optional: first-answer refinement moves from JSONL polling to the Stop-hook-driven turn-complete endpoint, and later-turn refinement runs with a debounce (>=5 turns AND >=10 min). Title-source semantics gain 'ai-explicit' for user-requested retitles; 'manual' and 'ai-explicit' are never auto-overwritten. Every title write emits a new conversation.title_changed domain event from the single write door updateConversationTitle(), which bumps conversationsListRevision so the sidebar updates without polling. A one-time backfill runs server-side via POST /api/admin/conversations/backfill-titles, driven by a new `pan admin conversations backfill-titles` CLI command: transcript-backed stuck rows are titled from the first user message, no-transcript rows get 'Untitled — <created date>', with a per-row report and --dry-run. All decisions, verified file:line references, and before/after context live in .pan/drafts/PAN-1644.md (decisions AD-1..AD-11).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No ongoing semantic topic-drift retitling (deferred to PAN-1646); later-turn refinement here is debounced transcript re-summarization only
- No schema migration and no title_locked column (Q1 chose precise source values)
- No renaming/migration of existing title_source values ('ai', 'ai-refined', NULL legacy rows keep their values)
- No boot-time automatic backfill (Q2 chose an operator-run admin command)
- No change to the 2s/10s conversation-list polling used for spawn/fork liveness; only title propagation stops depending on it
- No new config surface for refinement cadence (module constants; config deferred)
- No weakening of internal-token auth on hook endpoints
- No titling changes for issue/work agents (agent-* sessions); conversations (conv-*) only
- No AI model calls on any deterministic path

autoDecisions.summary: Dedicated hook endpoints in routes/hooks.ts modeled on postPermissionEventRoute, both requiring the internal token
autoDecisions.rationale: permission-event already proves the session_id->conversation->emitOnly pattern; memory routes prove the token check; stricter auth is the safe default (AD-1)

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve conversations by session_id via conversation_files.locator only; unknown session is a silent no-op
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue explicitly requires session-id resolution, not tmux/agent id; getConversationByClaudeSessionId already exists (AD-2)

autoDecisions.summary: Deterministic titling applies only when titleSource='default'; 'auto' titles are not re-derived on later prompts
autoDecisions.rationale: 'auto' already means prompt-derived; re-deriving every prompt would thrash titles — later improvement belongs to AI refinement (AD-4)

autoDecisions.summary: Later-turn cadence: refine 'ai-refined' titles only after >=5 turn-completes AND >=10 minutes, tracked in-memory per conversation
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator chose to add cadence now (Q3); DB titleSource distinguishes first vs later refinement so only counters need memory; restart reset is acceptable (AD-6)

autoDecisions.summary: conversation.title_changed is emitted inside updateConversationTitle() with a try/catch guard around getEventStore()
autoDecisions.rationale: Single write door means every writer emits; getEventStore() throws before initEventStore() so non-server contexts must not crash (AD-7)

autoDecisions.summary: Backfill executes server-side via POST /api/admin/conversations/backfill-titles; the CLI is a thin client that errors when the dashboard is down
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the single write door and event emission; avoids a second process writing the live SQLite DB (AD-8)

autoDecisions.summary: scheduleTitleRefinement() polling loop is deleted, not kept as fallback
autoDecisions.rationale: No-loss audit: the turn-complete service preserves first-answer refinement and adds cadence; keeping both would double-refine (AD-11)

narrative.Action: Add export function derivePromptTitle(prompt: string): string to src/lib/conversations/transcript-summary.ts, reusing the compaction rules of fallbackTranscriptTitle (lines 111-144: strip fenced code blocks, inline backticks, URLs, filler phrases like 'please/can you/help me', collapse whitespace, first 8 words, trim trailing conjunctions/punctuation, sanitizeTitle) applied directly to the raw prompt string instead of a serialized transcript. When compaction yields an empty string but the trimmed prompt is non-empty, fall back to the creation-path truncation: prompt.slice(0, 60) + ('…' when longer) — same formula as conversation-runtime.ts:733-734. Return '' only for empty/whitespace-only prompts. Pure function, zero model calls.

POST /api/hooks/user-prompt-submit — immediate deterministic titling

narrative.Action: Add postUserPromptSubmitRoute to src/dashboard/server/routes/hooks.ts modeled on postPermissionEventRoute (lines 349-393) but WITH the internal-token check used by postMemoryTurnRoute (hasDashboardInternalToken, line 328 — return 401 when missing). Body: {session_id: string, prompt: string}. Resolve conv = getConversationByClaudeSessionId(session_id) (src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts:996); return {ok:true} no-op when null. When conv.titleSource === 'default' and derivePromptTitle(prompt) is non-empty: updateConversationTitle(conv.name, derivedTitle, 'auto') — unconditionally, with NO isBackgroundFeatureEnabled/cheapMode gate on this deterministic step. Then, when isBackgroundFeatureEnabled('conversationTitles') is true, fire-and-forget generateAiTitle(conv.name, prompt, deps) exactly like the existing call sites (void + catch-log). When titleSource is anything other than 'default', skip titling entirely. Register the route in hooksRouteLayer (line 395).

narrative.Action: In sync-sources/hooks/user-prompt-submit-hook, after the existing three pan_emit_event calls and using the already-resolved INTERNAL_TOKEN (lines 34-40), add a jq-guarded block (same shape as the memory-inject block at lines 42-50) that builds {session_id: (.session_id // ""), prompt: (.prompt // .message // .input // "")} from $INPUT and POSTs it to "$PAN_DASHBOARD_URL/api/hooks/user-prompt-submit" with curl -s -m 1 and the x-overdeck-internal-token header. Turn-complete title refinement service with first-answer + debounced later-turn cadence

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/overdeck/title-refinement.ts exporting async function handleTurnComplete(conv: LegacyConversation, deps: {resolveSessionFile: ...}): Promise<void> plus a resetTitleRefinementState() test helper. Logic: (1) return immediately unless isBackgroundFeatureEnabled('titleRefinement') — this also covers cheapMode; (2) return unless canRefineTitle(conv) (from bead title-source-ai-explicit); (3) maintain a module-level Map<conversationName, {turnsSinceRefine: number, lastRefinedAtMs: number}>; increment turnsSinceRefine on every eligible turn-complete; (4) first refinement (titleSource in {'default','auto','ai'}): refine now; later refinement (titleSource === 'ai-refined'): refine only when turnsSinceRefine >= LATER_REFINE_MIN_TURNS (5) AND Date.now() - lastRefinedAtMs >= LATER_REFINE_MIN_INTERVAL_MS (600_000) — module constants; (5) refine = resolve session file via deps.resolveSessionFile(conv), getCachedMessages, require at least one completed assistant message, serializeConversationTranscript, summarizeTranscriptTitle(transcript, configuredTitleModel()), then re-fetch the conversation, re-check canRefineTitle, and updateConversationTitle(name, refined, 'ai-refined') — mirroring the body of the current scheduleTitleRefinement tick (conversation-reads.ts:667-764) minus the polling loop; (6) reset counters after a successful refine; (7) guard against concurrent refines per conversation (in-flight set). REPO RULE restated: all cadence tests MUST use vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync()/setSystemTime — no real waits.

items.title: Given titleSource='auto' and a transcript with a completed assistant message, handleTurnComplete persists an 'ai-refined' title via updateConversationTitle
Given titleSource='ai-refined', handleTurnComplete refines again only after >=5 turn-completes AND >=10 minutes (fake-timer test advances clock; earlier calls write nothing)
Conversations with titleSource 'manual', 'ai-explicit', or null are never refined, and nothing runs when titleRefinement is disabled or cheapMode=true
A turn-complete with no completed assistant message in the transcript persists no title change and preserves the cadence counters for the next turn
POST /api/hooks/turn-complete + delete the scheduleTitleRefinement polling loop

narrative.Action: Add postTurnCompleteRoute to src/dashboard/server/routes/hooks.ts: internal-token required (401 without), body {session_id: string}, resolve via getConversationByClaudeSessionId, {ok:true} no-op when unresolved, otherwise fire-and-forget handleTurnComplete(conv, {resolveSessionFile}) from title-refinement.ts (void + catch-log; respond immediately, never await the model). Register in hooksRouteLayer. Then delete scheduleTitleRefinement (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-reads.ts:667-764), its refinementScheduled set, and its single call site at conversation-reads.ts:664 inside generateAiTitle. No-loss audit note: first-answer refinement behavior is preserved by handleTurnComplete (verified by refinement-service tests); the deleted code's 'ai'->'ai-refined' transition and manual-title bailout both exist in the new service.

Backfill: POST /api/admin/conversations/backfill-titles + pan admin conversations backfill-titles

narrative.Action: Server: add POST /api/admin/conversations/backfill-titles to src/dashboard/server/routes/admin.ts (which mirrors the pan admin namespace). Body {dryRun?: boolean}. Select non-archived conversations WHERE title='New conversation' (any title_source, including NULL). For each: resolve the session file with the same resolveSessionFile dependency the conversation routes use; if a first user message exists, candidate = derivePromptTitle(firstUserMessage) with source 'auto' and reason 'transcript'; otherwise candidate = 'Untitled — ' + created_at formatted YYYY-MM-DD, source 'auto', reason 'no transcript'. When not dryRun, write via updateConversationTitle (events emitted). Respond {updated: [{name, title, reason}], skipped: [{name, reason}], dryRun}. CLI: add 'conversations' group to src/cli/commands/admin/ (new conversations-handler.ts, registered in admin/index.ts) with subcommand backfill-titles [--dry-run]; it POSTs to the dashboard (same base-URL + internal-token pattern as other admin handlers), prints a per-row report table and totals, and exits non-zero with a clear 'dashboard not running — start it with pan up' message when unreachable. Skills lockstep (repo rule): adding a pan admin subcommand requires the wrapper-skill check — update the relevant pan-admin skill or the documented exclusion list in docs/SKILLS-CONVENTION.md in the same commit so scripts/lint-skills.sh (npm run lint) passes.
